note: Campbell County's 1,000-acre lake park south of Alexandria (Northern Kentucky, ~25 mi from Cincinnati). Sites 47-53 and The Point take 35-ft rigs, the 12 RV sites off Flatwoods Rd take 50 ft, and many older sites are 20-28 ft - pick carefully. The Point and a few shore sites sit on the lake. Campground and lake closed for the 2026 season for lake dredging. --Claude
